translations.text: And when he acted like someone who wanted to cry out, I struck him down on the ground.
I held his chest down with my feet while standing and calling to the brothers whom I could see around me, supporting me throughout this struggle: “Grab this other one!”

For I was thinking to myself that it is impossible for a human being to overcome a spirit or an angel of God. Rather, people fall to the ground from fear when they see them, and those who have appeared to them can barely give them strength. Such was my thought.

And look, the two quickly revealed themselves to be demons. And I realized that this was Satan’s effort to deceive the crowds gathered in places, so that they would tolerate the mysteries and the ungodliness of those who do scandalous deeds among them, until the weeds far outnumbered the good seed.
For people have chosen to please those counted among the evildoers rather than to please God.

This is how it is: one person was not expelled because of his father, because they feel ashamed before him; another because of his brother; another because of an empty desire; another because of hypocrisy and favoritism; and others because they seek the favor of those who are defiled and rejected. Everything is done for people and not for Jesus, as we have said many times in many places—not only we ourselves, but also those before us who were truly chosen by God.
But I have told you, brothers, that the enemy leads astray many of those who readily believe every word and every spirit.
This is what happens in many places: many fight on behalf of ungodliness because they put their trust in deceiving spirits and the teachings of demons.
Indeed, it is not an evil thing if a person who loves Christ fights with a good spirit when it appears to him.
The spirit itself loves him all the more and rejoices over him.
For it knows that he is not opposing it, but is being watchful and taking care not to bow down to a demon and come under the authority of a spirit [?], thinking that it is a holy [?] angel.
